name: Look Atlas
tagline: Premium AI product photography with reusable AI Directors for fashion, jewelry, and ecommerce
description: Look Atlas is an AI product photography studio for fashion, jewelry, and ecommerce teams that need consistent, editorial-quality imagery across a collection. Start with an existing product photo and choose a reusable AI Director to guide lighting, styling, and framing. Add close-up references for details that matter at catalog scale, such as embroidery, fabric texture, jewelry settings, and hardware. Use the same direction to produce on-model catalog photos, campaign imagery, and lifestyle scenes. The first shoot includes 15 watermarked 2K images, with no card required. Paid plans start at $49/month.
